title: [clinic · EX-17] Measure position sensitivity for real
body:
> **Exercise clinic.** One long-running thread per exercise. Ask here rather than opening a
> new thread — the answers accumulate where the next person will look for them.
>
> **Exercise:** [`EX-17` — Measure position sensitivity for real](https://github.com/akash-coded/nanorag/blob/main/docs/30-learning/exercises/ex-17-measure-position-sensitivity-for-real.md) · difficulty 🔴

## What this exercise asks

Read the exercise first; this thread is for when you are stuck, not instead of it.

## Three ways people get stuck on this one

**1.** Measuring against the extractive generator and reporting it as a model result. It measures the packer, not attention.

**2.** Not running an ungrounded control, so packer artefacts are attributed to position.

**3.** One `k` only. The effect is expected to grow with context length; a single short context says little.

## How to ask here

Post the **numbers you got**, the **config that produced them**, and **what you already tried**.
A question with a measurement in it gets answered in one round trip; a question without one
takes three.

If you have finished it, post the write-up in **Show and Tell** with the
`[solution · EX-17]` prefix rather than here — this thread stays for people who are stuck.
